records.jp: ふう……
records.en_original: Phew...
records.en_auxiliary: Phew...
records.en: Phew...

records.jp: 周りは水に囲まれて
records.en_original: Totally surrounded by water.
records.en_auxiliary: Totally surrounded by water.
records.en: Totally surrounded by water.

records.jp: 人は私たち四人だけ
records.en_original: Just the four of us.
records.en_auxiliary: Just the four of us.
records.en: Just the four of us.

records.jp: 私以外全員、昔の記憶がなくて……
records.en_original: And everyone but me has lost their memory...
records.en_auxiliary: And everyone but me has lost their memory...
records.en: And everyone but me has lost their memory...

records.jp: “向こうの世界”とかいうもっと意味わかんない<CR>空間があり……
records.en_original: Not to mention that we don't understand a thing about the Faraway...
records.en_auxiliary: Not to mention that we don't understand a thing about the Faraway...
records.en: Then there's the even more incomprehensible space<CR>they call the Faraway...

records.jp: なぜか全員持ってる指輪で、武器を出して戦える
records.en_original: Just that we fight demons using weapons that come out of these rings we all have.
records.en_auxiliary: Just that we fight demons using weapons that come out of these rings we all have.
records.en: For some reason, the rings we all have let us summon weapons and fight.

records.jp: はぁー、わけわかんない！<CR>なんなんだこの世界はー！
records.en_original: Ugh, I just don’t understand! What is this place?!
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh, I just don’t understand! What is this place?!
records.en: Ugh, I just don’t understand!<CR>What is this place?!

records.jp: ん？　フリスペ……？
records.en_original: Hmm? My FreeSpace?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm? My FreeSpace?
records.en: Hmm? My FreeSpace?

records.jp: おはー！<CR>どこ行ったん？？
records.en_original: Morning! Where'd u go?
records.en_auxiliary: Morning! Where'd u go?
records.en: Morning!<CR>Where'd u go?

records.jp: 空に近いところ
records.en_original: Way up high
records.en_auxiliary: Way up high
records.en: Way up high

records.jp: はは
records.en_original: Haha.
records.en_auxiliary: Haha.
records.en: Haha.

records.jp: ……にしても、フリスぺか
records.en_original: FreeSpace, huh...
records.en_auxiliary: FreeSpace, huh...
records.en: FreeSpace, huh...

records.jp: （「フリスぺ！」なんて名前のアプリ、<CR>元いた世界では聞いたことない）
records.en_original: (I'd never heard of any app called "FreeSpace" until I came here.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'd never heard of any app called "FreeSpace" until I came here.)
records.en: (I'd never heard of any app called<CR>"FreeSpace" until I came here.)

records.jp: （補習で学校に行く途中、スマホを落としたことに<CR>気が付いて……）
records.en_original: (I remember dropping my phone on the way to summer classes...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I remember dropping my phone on the way to summer classes...)
records.en: (I remember dropping my phone<CR>on the way to summer classes...)

records.jp: （拾った時には、このアプリが入ってた。<CR>そして……）
records.en_original: (When I found it, this app was on it. And then...)
records.en_auxiliary: (When I found it, this app was on it. And then...)
records.en: (When I found it, this app was on it.<CR>And then...)

records.jp: うまれかわれ
records.en_original: Be Reborn
records.en_auxiliary: Be Reborn
records.en: Be Reborn

records.jp: （このメッセージが残されていた）
records.en_original: (This message was on the screen.)
records.en_auxiliary: (This message was on the screen.)
records.en: (This message was on the screen.)

records.jp: （そして今はフリスぺ以外のアプリは、<CR>全部使えなくなっている）
records.en_original: (And I couldn't use any of my apps other than FreeSpace.)
records.en_auxiliary: (And I couldn't use any of my apps other than FreeSpace.)
records.en: (And now every app except FreeSpace<CR>has stopped working.)

records.jp: （……もしかして、これのせいで私、<CR>この世界に飛ばされた？）
records.en_original: (Is this how I was sent to this world?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Is this how I was sent to this world?)
records.en: (Could this be what sent me<CR>to this world?)

records.jp: （だとしたら、スマホにフリスぺを入れた人。<CR>それが、私をこの世界に連れてきた犯人だ）
records.en_original: (If that's the case, whoever put FreeSpace on my phone is the one who brought me here.)
records.en_auxiliary: (If that's the case, whoever put FreeSpace on my phone is the one who brought me here.)
records.en: (If that's the case,<CR>whoever put FreeSpace on my phone is the one who brought me here.)

records.en_original: Hmmmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmmmm...
records.en: Hmmmm...

records.jp: あなた……
records.en_original: You...
records.en_auxiliary: You...
records.en: You...

records.jp: えっ……だ、誰――
records.en_original: Aah! Who's there?!
records.en_auxiliary: Aah! Who's there?!
records.en: Huh...? Wh-who—

records.jp: ――あなたは何者？　なぜ、この世界にいるの？
records.en_original: Who are you? Why are you here?
records.en_auxiliary: Who are you? Why are you here?
records.en: Who are you? Why are you in this world?

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: あなたは何者？　なぜ、この世界にいるの？
records.en_original: Who are you? Why are you here?
records.en_auxiliary: Who are you? Why are you here?
records.en: Who are you? Why are you here?

records.jp: どのくらいの人がこの問いに自信を持って<CR>答えられるのだろう
records.en_original: I wonder how many people can answer that question with confidence.
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder how many people can answer that question with confidence.
records.en: I wonder how many people could answer that question<CR>with confidence.

records.jp: ずっと何者かになりたいと思っていた。<CR>特別な何かを持つ何者かに
records.en_original: Ever since I can remember, I wanted to be somebody. Somebody special.
records.en_auxiliary: Ever since I can remember, I wanted to be somebody. Somebody special.
records.en: I've always wanted to be somebody.<CR>Somebody with something special.

records.jp: この不思議な世界で、帰り道を失くした迷子の私は
records.en_original: I was just a lost girl, looking for her way home.
records.en_auxiliary: I was just a lost girl, looking for her way home.
records.en: In this mysterious world, I was a lost girl with no way home,

records.jp: いくつもの“特別”と出会うことになる
records.en_original: I found the "special" that I had been looking for.
records.en_auxiliary: I found the "special" that I had been looking for.
records.en: and I would come to encounter many forms of 'special.'

records.jp: 長い長い、夏休みの始まりだ――
records.en_original: It was the beginning of a long, long summer.
records.en_auxiliary: It was the beginning of a long, long summer.
records.en: It was the beginning of a long, long summer.

records.jp: （それにしても……「うまれかわれ」って、何に……？<CR>私へのメッセージなのかな……？）
records.en: (Still... What am I supposed to be 'reborn' as...?<CR>Was that message meant for me...?)
